series_tags._comment: Put first; the combined list is trimmed to YouTube's 500-character limit. Keyword research (vidIQ) 6 Nov 2026.

_title_variants: Title B (23 Nov 2026): variations of the winning problem statement 'How well do you REALLY know X?' (Cartoons #14 A beat the 'every dummy' B 57% to 43%; #9 B led 56% but YouTube kept A). The Monday run moves to the next entry in title_b_queue each week and records it in quiz.json title_b_variant. No invented statistics: 'Most people can't score 40/50' is a challenge, keep it only while results support it.

studio_education.problems: one line per question: timecode then the question

thumbnail_taglines._comment: Bottom line of the thumbnail (scripts/make_thumbnails.py). It must read on from the heading, e.g. 'Disney Quiz #10' then 'Only REAL fans would know' (Giulia 10 Nov). quiz.json thumbnail_tagline overrides.

thumbnail_test._comment: Giulia, 16 Nov 2026: 'We should always be running thumbnail tests across all quiz videos.' Every long video has a Title and thumbnail test; A and B change ONE thing, and each change should be big enough to move click-through rate. Queue: band colour (red vs blue), then hook wording, then a big '50 QUESTIONS' number + 4-picture grid (1M+ style), then a single question on the thumbnail. Update from the weekly results.

levels._comment: Studio Education level per quiz difficulty. Fill in Studio's exact option names once seen; until then the task picks the closest option.
